description: Council-authorized DEX rebalance Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 — emitted by `kawase_rebalance_proposer` cell as a candidate when |driftBps| > 500 (5%) for a paired pool, then Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 signs the attestation chain, then `KawaseYuiPool.rebalance()` consumes the signed record and executes the swap via the named DEX (R1 default: Aerodrome on Base). Rebalance frequency target: ≤1/month R1, ≤1/quarter R2. swapRateBps MUST be within ±100 bps (1%) of chainlinkRateBpsAtAttest (G6 yield-farming-adjacent risk avoidance; structurally tighter than the per-tx G4 ±0.5% band because aggregate slippage matters more on larger swaps).

rebalanceId.description: Monotonic UUID for this rebalance (kotoba content-addressed).

swapAmountMinor.description: Amount of fromStable being swapped (minor units). MUST be ≤ 10% of the weaker pool's balance at proposer time.

swapRateBps.description: Quoted execution rate at the named DEX (basis points). MUST be within ±100 bps of chainlinkRateBpsAtAttest.

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of Council members who attested this rebalance. R1+ ≥4 (Lv6+ ≥4/7 multisig threshold).

dexAddress.description: Base L2 address of the Council-approved DEX (R1 default = Aerodrome `0xcF77a3Ba9A5CA399B7c97c74d54e5b1Beb874E43`). Council-approved set governed by separate ADR/Lexicon.

preSwapDriftBps.description: |driftBps| from poolStateReport that triggered this proposal. MUST be > 500.

txHash.description: Set AFTER execution. Absent on the candidate record before Council sign-off + on-chain execution.

postSwapDriftBps.description: Set AFTER execution. Should be near 0; |postSwapDriftBps| > 100 = anomalous slippage, triggers chigiri.disputeMediation.
